SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__access: Accessing a rigged system: Technical Rating TN, Vigilance Code successes, tap, decryption and protocols, Rigger 2 p. 79 (book) or not built (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__accessAle: The alert a failed decryption or protocol test sets (Rigger 2 p. 79: on alert)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__ccss: CCSS limits: a security rigger operates Intelligence parts of the system and commands RC deck rating drones, CSH p. 102 (book) or not shown (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__ccssPools: Security rigger's pools: none on a device's detection test while assuming the body, Rigger 2 p. 78 (book) or the Control Pool may add (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__design: Vehicle design calculator: chassis, Design Points and the Mark-Up Factor, Rigger 2 pp. 108–114, 170–171 (book) or none (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__modSpecs: Modification prices and Installation Tests per item, Rigger 2 pp. 120–140 (book) or the table's cost × rating and TN 4 + rating (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__motion: Motion and vibration sensors: the intruder's Stealth Test against the rating with movement modifiers, CSH pp. 99–100 (book) or the opposed detection test (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__perceptio: Rigger perception table: the security rigger's Perception Test by what happened, Rigger 2 p. 77 (book) or none (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__ratings: Security ratings table: device ratings and the Overall Security Level by the site's security levels, CSH pp. 94–100 (book) or not built (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__repairPar: Repair parts: 5% of the vehicle's cost per box, Rigger 2 p. 26 (book) or not shown (v971)
Repair parts: percent of the vehicle's cost per box (Rigger 2 p. 26: 5)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__riggerCom: Rigger combat and decking a rigged system: opposed Willpower, (Willpower)L Stun, Rigger 2 pp. 79–80 (book) or not built (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VSEC_V98__riggerDec: Riggers decking: +1 TN on Matrix tests and Hacking Pool − VCR level, Rigger 2 p. 16 (book) or no penalty (v971)
